name: Ribbons-TS-TW
title: Physics Ribbon Trail
blurb: Colored ribbons trail the cursor with spring physics.
description: Renders WebGL ribbons following pointer position using spring physics. Each ribbon has independent physics parameters and optional shader wave effects or fade.
use_when: Full-screen hero backgrounds or interactive effects on dark surfaces.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices (tracks pointer only); requires a sized parent container.
a11y: Canvas wrapper only; no keyboard interaction or prefers-reduced-motion support.
